AccessGrant.description:
``POST /documents/<id>/access`` — exactly one subject, one level.

``subject_kind`` is explicit rather than inferred from which field is
present: an ACL write that guesses its own meaning is one typo away
from granting to a subject the caller did not name.

AppendResultDTO.description: Outcome of a journal append batch.

BreadcrumbNodeDTO.description: One ancestor folder on a search hit's path.

DocumentAccessPresenterDTO.description:
Presents one whitelist grant as a share-sheet row.

``suspended`` is the kill-switch state (axis §3): true when the row
exists but its mode is switched off, so the sheet says "paused by
configuration" instead of hiding a grant the admin would then believe
was revoked.

subject.description: The user id for subject_kind=user, the container reference for subject_kind=ref.

suspended.description: The grant exists but its sharing mode is switched off for this deployment — inert, not revoked.

DocumentLinkPresenterDTO.description:
Presents one bearer link to whoever may administer sharing.

The token IS in this envelope — a share sheet that cannot re-show the
link it minted is a sheet that makes people mint a second one — which is
exactly why the listing endpoint is gated on ``docs.share.link`` and why
no ``document.share.*`` EVENT carries it.

first_redeemed_at.description: When the link was first opened successfully; stamped once.

suspended.description: The link exists but link sharing is switched off for this deployment — inert, not revoked.

DocumentPresenterDTO.description:
Presents a Document row as the API envelope. The three registry-derived
fields (editor_hint/collab/diffable) degrade to file-type presentation
when the type is unknown — never an error (storage-verdict §7.3).

collab.description: Write discipline of the type: "crdt" or "snapshot".

diffable.description: Whether line-diff rendering is meaningful for this type.

folder_id.description: Containing folder id; null for the workspace root.

deleted_at.description: Set while the document sits in the trash.

is_starred.description: Whether the requesting user starred this; null when the request carries no user (not applicable is not false).

DownloadUrlDTO.description: Opaque presigned GET URL — clients must never assume its shape.

FolderPresenterDTO.description: Presents a Folder row as the API tree node.

parent_id.description: Parent folder id; null for workspace roots.

deleted_at.description: Set while the folder sits in the trash.

is_starred.description: Whether the requesting user starred this; null when the request carries no user (not applicable is not false).

JournalUpdateDTO.description: One journal row of the ``?since=`` replay feed.

PatchedDocumentPatch.description: title/metadata = edit; folder_id (null = to root) = manage.

PatchedFolderPatch.description: rename (name) = edit; move (parent_id, null = to root) = manage.

RevisionPresenterDTO.description: Presents a Revision pointer row (a self-contained full snapshot, I1).

SaveResultDTO.description: Outcome of an accepted content save (PUT content / revision restore).

SearchHitDTO.description:
One name-search hit (drive-spec §3.3).

``kind`` dispatches the client's rendering; ``breadcrumb`` is the
root-first ancestor chain of the hit's CONTAINER (empty at the workspace
root), materialized server-side so a result list costs one request.

SharedDocumentDTO.description:
What a link BEARER sees: the document, and nothing around it.

The stripped envelope of axis §6 — no workspace, no folder, no owner,
no star state, no revision history. A link grants a document, not a
seat: anything that would let the holder infer the shape of the
workspace (its tree, who is in it, what else it contains) is deliberately
absent, and history is absent besides, because an old revision can hold
text that was deleted on purpose since.

``level`` is what the presenter may DO with it, so a client can render
a read-only editor without guessing from a 403 it has not hit yet.

TrashPurgeResultDTO.description: Counts of irreversibly purged trash items.

UploadTicketDTO.description:
Pending direct-to-storage upload: the document row exists already
(hidden from listings) and ``put_url`` is the presigned PUT target.

``expires_at`` is the instant the ticket stops being spendable (null
only when the host disabled the TTL) — a client that cannot see the
deadline cannot honour it.
